facts.value: Eligible if previously attended ASU but not enrolled for up to seven consecutive fall or spring semesters.
No new application or application fee needed; sign in to My ASU to register for classes.
May have a hold or Priority Task that needs to be completed before class registration.
Must submit official transcripts from all institutions attended during absence; they must be mailed or sent electronically directly to Admission Services.
ASU does not accept transcripts sent or carried by hand by applicants or transmitted by fax.
International students (F1/J1 visa) must contact ASU's International Students and Scholars Center to submit documentation for the issuance of an I-20 for visa purposes.
Eligible for quick re-entry if absence is due to military deployment, service on an official church mission, service with a foreign aid service of the federal government, or a permanent disability.
